season.note: Throughout Twilight Trails, different days of the week will include a Daily Discovery experience. These will be active between 12:00 a.m. and 11:59 p.m. local time unless otherwise stated. Daily Discoveries may change as Scopely Explore experiments with how to make the best experience. Please note: Daily Discoveries will not be available during the week of global GO Fest, GO Wild Area, and GO Tour events. Daily Discoveries will not take place from November 9 through November 15, 2026.

spawns.description:
A different set of Pokémon will be featured on each event day—Saturday, December 12, and Sunday, December 13, 2026—from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time.
The Pokémon that appear during this time will have the same chance of appearing as a Shiny Pokémon as those that appeared during their original Community Days, and they may also appear with a Special Background. Outside of these times, any of the featured Pokémon may appear from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time on either Saturday or Sunday!
The following Pokémon will be featured on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time.
The following Pokémon will be featured on Sunday, December 13, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time.
